entities.summary: Faustino Reyes López is a former boxer from Spain, who represented his native country at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona, Spain. There he won the silver medal in the featherweight division, after being defeated in the final by Germany's Andreas Tews. He was born in Marchena, Seville and is of Romani descent.
